candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m composite DTM is a bare-earth raster covering about 99% of England, merged from Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Where repeats exist the newest best-resolution data is used; resampled inputs use bilinear interpolation. Data is in ODN using OSTN15 and constituent surveys have +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: The composite is not a single acquisition and its 1m grid spacing does not identify the source survey or define vertical accuracy; metadata-index lineage is required per parcel.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m composite DTM uses the same bare-earth composite process from Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Repeat surveys and bilinear resampling are part of the composite lineage and the underlying survey accuracy contract remains distinct from output grid spacing.
semantic_limits: A 2m composite cell must not be treated as a direct survey observation or assigned uncertainty solely from its 2m horizontal resolution.
